headline: Milan stocks slide on inflation fears and renewed conflict; dividend payouts weigh
summary: Piazza Affari opened the week lower as the dividend effect amplified losses on the FTSE MIB. Broader markets stayed risk-off on inflation concerns and renewed conflict.
why: The FTSE MIB is the benchmark index of Italy's largest listed companies, so its moves reflect Italian equities and the wider euro-area risk mood.
